name: R-11: a fresh public build sends no telemetry before opt-in
command: VM osr18b (fresh overlay, desktop booted from b98518640b8d per README): sudo tcpdump -n -i any '(udp port 53) or (tcp SYN and not 127/8 and not 10.0.2.2)' for 240s, 06:20:57Z-06:24:57Z
positive control inside the window: getent hosts r11-positive-control.example.com; curl https://example.com
summary: The running app sent nothing to the network before opt-in. Over the 240s window the only outbound SYN was the control curl (104.20.23.154:443), and the only DNS queries were for the two control names. The instrument saw both control actions, so it was capturing. In code, telemetry-flush.ts forwards only when NODE_ENV=production and (setup_wizard_state.telemetry_enabled or PAPERCUSP_INTERNAL_BUILD=true). A fresh install has neither. Caveat: this was a README dev boot, so NODE_ENV was not production. The capture shows zero egress. The production path is covered by the code review (D-010).

assertions.evidence: tcpdump: 27 lines, 38 packets. The only SYN was to 104.20.23.154.443 (the control). DNS: example.com and r11-positive-control.example.com only (the controls).
Both control actions appear in the capture, so a telemetry request would have been seen.
